A tender monitoring platform in three steps

Describe what you do once. Veillea reads the official sources every day and shows you only what matters.

  1. Create your profile. Keywords in French and English, categories (UNSPSC/GSIN), regions. Several profiles if you have several lines of business.
  2. Veillea collects and matches. Notices from official sources are imported, normalized and matched to your profiles, in both languages.
  3. Focus on the best ones. Ranked results, bilingual summaries, deadline badges: you decide quickly whether to bid or not.

A tender monitoring tool built for fast decisions

Results ranked by relevance

Every notice gets a score based on your keywords and categories, in French and English. The most relevant come first.

Automatic FR/EN summaries

For every notice, a clear summary in both languages: scope of the mandate, buyer, closing date. No need to read 40 pages to know whether it's for you. The summary is for sorting; the official notice always prevails.

Deadline badges and filters

See at a glance what closes this week. Filter by source, category, region or date.

Source status

Check the date of each source's last update and the number of notices imported.

Bilingual from A to Z

Matching and summaries in French and English: a SEAO notice published only in French (or a federal notice in English) won't slip past you.

Veillea or SEAO matching: what's the difference?

SEAO offers its own alert service, "jumelage" (matching), which requires a paid user subscription. Here is the comparison, based on the fee schedule published by SEAO.

SEAO matching Veillea
Price $6.95/month per Specialist user + $0.35 per notice sent Free (SEAO, weekly) · Solo $35/month · Team $69/month · Enterprise from $199/month — flat price
Sources SEAO only SEAO, CanadaBuys, SaskTenders, City of Toronto and 9 US sources (Team and Enterprise)
Ranking Notices matching your criteria Every notice scored against your profile, most relevant first

Matching languages SEAO search profile French and English keywords
Users Subscription per Specialist user 1 to 5 users, unlimited on Enterprise

Example: if matching sends you 100 notices in a month, the SEAO bill reaches $6.95 + $35.00 = $41.95, for a single source. With Veillea Solo, it's $35 a month, no matter how many notices, federal and Quebec contracts included.

SEAO fees taken from its fee schedule (seao.gouv.qc.ca), checked on October 12, 2026. Veillea doesn't replace registering with SEAO: to get the documents and submit a bid, you still use the official platform.

Frequently asked questions

Is there free tender monitoring?

Yes. Veillea's Free plan covers SEAO with a weekly digest and one monitoring profile. Paid plans add federal and Quebec contracts (Solo) or Quebec, federal and US contracts (Team and Enterprise), daily or real-time alerts and FR/EN summaries, with a 14-day trial and no credit card.

Which tender sources are covered?

In Canada: SEAO (Québec), CanadaBuys (federal), SaskTenders (Saskatchewan) and the City of Toronto. Veillea also covers several US sources, such as SAM.gov. Solo covers federal and Quebec contracts; Team and Enterprise include Quebec, federal and US contracts at no extra cost.

How is AI used in the monitoring?

Every notice is automatically matched to your profile, ranked by relevance and summarized in French and English. The summary helps you sort; the official notice always prevails.

Does Veillea replace registering with SEAO?

No. Veillea helps you find the relevant notices. To get the documents and submit your bid, you still go through the official platform.

How is it different from SEAO matching?

Matching costs $6.95 per month per Specialist user plus $0.35 per notice sent, and covers only SEAO. Veillea offers a flat price, adds CanadaBuys and other sources, ranks notices against your profile and summarizes them in two languages.

Can I change plans or cancel?

Yes, at any time from your account; charges are prorated. The 14-day trial has no commitment: at the end, you choose a plan or switch to Free.
